title: At work: Home cleaning after moving in
prompt:
A vertical 9:16 walk-through tour ad for a local service business in Rwanda. Setting: a tidy Kigali workshop. Light: practical workshop light. Music: steady, confident beat.
0-3s: Macro shot, shallow depth of field, in slow motion: skilled hands and tools at work on the Home cleaning after moving in. Sound: tools clicking.
3-7s: Medium shot, waist up, smooth gimbal walk-through: around the workbench while the job gets done.
7-9s: Close-up, rack focus from the foreground to the subject: from the tools to the finished work.
9-12s: Clean hero shot, subject centred, locked-off static camera: the finished job, clean and ready. A warm voice-over says in English: "Book your spot at Urugo Homes."
No on-screen text or added logos.
notes: No product photo: Seedance will imagine the Home cleaning after moving in from the words. Add a photo as Image 1 so it looks exactly like yours.
